text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor of the long-distance Arima 
Kinen was Yamanin Zephyr. As if distance 
barriers didn't exist, she achieved 
four-division domination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio challenges Yamanin Zephyr to a 
rematch, declaring that this time, she 
will definitely catch the wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr promised to accept the 
challenge as many times as it took. For 
the wind is something that never ceases to 
blow—
